scientific_integrity.limitations: Not established for noninjective periods, arbitrary gap languages, nonadjacent-gap constraints or multiplicities of embeddings. No independent validation.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: The self-contained verify.py tests independently enumerated query languages against the formula and saturation conditions.
scientific_integrity.scope: Exact cardinality, generating polynomial and saturation thresholds for distinct interval-gap-constrained subsequences of a power of a permutation. All integers q>=2, k>=1, h>=1 and all positive integral position-gap bounds.

title: Exact gap-constrained subsequence spectra of repeated permutation words
